fact: RURA Board Decision No 03/BD/ICT/RURA/2024 of 11 October 2024 sets Universal Access Fund contribution rates of 2% of annual turnover for network infrastructure and network services licensees, 0.5% for retail ISPs and postal licensees.
title: Board Decision N° 03/BD/ICT/RURA/2024 of 11 October 2024 determining the Universal Access Fund contribution rates
